project.title: Clover WarRoom
project.purpose: Provide an owner-controlled evidence and decision workspace while keeping private case material outside public Core.

privacy.boundarySummary: No legal evidence, communications, deadlines, identities, documents, or case content are present; this capsule carries only minimized project state.

blockers: Canonical repository, branch, source commit, deployment, and rollback identities are not verified.
Any future runtime must prove a private-data boundary before private material is connected.
unknowns: Whether a distinct WarRoom repository or deployment currently exists.
Whether any prior receipt has been accepted by the owner.

dependencies.relationship: Uses governance, authority, and receipt contracts without moving private evidence into Core.
May reference permitted evidence pointers while source material remains access-controlled.

activeOwnerDecision.summary: The first handoff is proposed and unapproved; it may reconcile only public identity and sanitized receipt metadata and must not access private case material.

recommendedNextAction.summary: After exact owner approval, reconcile public repository and deployment identities and return a sanitized source-bound receipt without reading private data.
recommendedNextAction.sourceBasis: The registry names the project but supplies no canonical source or deployment identity.

rollbackAnchors.identity: No WarRoom state may change during identity reconciliation
